# Tweet thread

1/ GitHub bills every Actions job rounded up to a whole minute. Across 270 public repos (7,460 sampled jobs), 10.9 % of billed minutes were never executed. Median repo: 28.0 % of its bill is rounding. I built a CLI that shows you yours.

2/ ciburn reads .github/workflows, pulls your run/job/step history into SQLite, and attaches observed minutes + money to every finding, with the estimate method printed next to it. 2026 rates. No LLM, no service. `uv tool install .` then `ciburn audit`.

3/ Same dataset: 59.6 % of repos cache deps, 4.1 % set a timeout on every job, 22 of 122 with schedules have a cron failing 3+ times in a row. Dataset + method: https://github.com/addiiiooo/ciburn
